Monthly international arrivals by nationality/residence, as downloaded from the respective official-statistics portals.
Coverage and publication lags differ: IT to Jul-2026 (provisional 2026), FR/DE/CH/ES/CA/TW/AU/AE to Aug-2026, NL/DK (Eurostat) to Jul-2026,
GB quarterly to 2026-Q2, US to Jul-2026, JP/KR/SG to Sep-2026 (JP last month = estimate).
Definitions differ (hotel arrivals vs border arrivals vs visitors; residence vs nationality); do not add up across sources.
